# MuJoCo 3.3.0 in High-Frequency Alternating Motor Shows Contact Drift and Unclosed Negative Test

> **Current answer:** No. The original author modified to elliptic friction but still exhibited drift; reducing the timestep to 1e-7 did not eliminate the drift, and 1e-6 also showed similar results. Only when the friction coefficients are set to 0 does the behavior become normal, which is only used as a reference for friction-relatedness, not as a solution for tasks with friction. The original thread has no root cause, patch, or passed regression test.

## Key terms

- Elliptic Friction Cone (椭圆摩擦锥)
- Simulation Timestep (仿真步长)
- Contact Drift (接触漂移)
- Negative Test (负试验)

## Problem and symptoms

- Why does MuJoCo exhibit unidirectional drift under high-frequency alternating drive and friction contact?
- The model continues to drift to the left under alternating drive.
- The drift is reduced after reducing the timestep but remains.

## Environment

- MuJoCo 3.3.0, Linux, original timestep=1e-4, high-frequency alternating motor and friction contact.

## Priority diagnostics

- The collaborator distinguished between the leftward drift in this thread and the slip observed when a friction-cone is subjected to forces in the document.
- Compared the behavior of pyramidal/elliptic friction cones, timestep from 1e-4 to 1e-7, and friction coefficients set to 0.

## Possible causes

- The original thread only identifies the phenomenon as being related to friction parameters and sensitive to the timestep; the root cause has not been confirmed.

## Attempts

- The original author modified the friction cone to elliptic according to the collaborator's suggestion.
- Reduced the timestep to 1e-6 and even 1e-7.
- Set the friction coefficients to 0 as a control.

## Result

- Elliptic friction did not eliminate the drift.
- The drift was reduced when the timestep was set to 1e-7, but remained; 1e-6 also showed similar results.
- When the friction coefficients are set to 0, the original author reported the behavior as normal.

## Limitations

- The original issue has not been closed, and there is no maintainer who has fixed it or passed regression test.
- Setting the friction coefficients to 0 is only used as a reference for friction-relatedness, not as a viable solution for tasks with friction.
- Reducing the timestep only lowers the magnitude, and cannot be considered a solution.

## Safety notes

- Before validating the contact control on real machines, independent convergence checks should be performed on the time step, friction model, and excitation frequency.
